description: This file defines the Timer class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, including enums for TimerState and TimerMode, a TimerItem struct, and method declarations for managing timers and JSONRPC communication.

classes.name: Timer
classes.description: A class representing a timer plugin that manages timers, handles JSONRPC communication, and emits timer events.

methods.description: Wrapper method to start a timer based on JSON parameters.

methods.description: Wrapper method to get the status of a timer based on JSON parameters.

methods.description: Wrapper method to retrieve all timers.
